text:
maria: Following the postmortem, we need concrete runbook edits for the recurring KV eviction incidents: owners, short triage steps, exact commands, and an automation path for oncall.

kevin: I can take the runbook PR. Plan: 3-step triage + command snippets + rollback.

sam: I'll add the root-cause notes (prefix skew -> KV growth) and test harness for long-prefix load.

lisa: Product wants a documented customer-rollback path and an opt-in higher eviction threshold for Dedicated.

akshay: oncall asks for an "approved mitigation" action from alerts so we don't paste commands during pager storms.

maria: Draft triage: 1) confirm alerts: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50` 2) contain: `redwoodctl models patch <m> --set cache.read_only=true` + scale pool 3) failover: route to quantized fallback if p95 > 500ms for 2m.

kevin: Commands to include:
```
redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2
redwoodctl traffic shift --from model-foo --to model-foo-quantized --percent 100
```
PR: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/901 (WIP).

runbook-bot: Action RB-901 created and assigned to kevin, due 1725636400.

maria: Owners/time: kevin PR by Fri EOD (1725636400), sam tests by Tue (1725885600), maria verify+merge by Thu (1726068400).

lisa: I'll add product notification template and rollback wording.

akshay: Filing infra ticket for safe-mitigation button: INFRA-1302.

kevin: Will add TL;DR at top of runbook for oncall. Will ping reviewers on Friday.

maria: Good. After merge, update the postmortem action tracker and tag infra for automation follow-up. If anyone needs to swap ownership, flag it here.
